name: YMCA of Orange County Volunteer Opportunities
city: Fullerton, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna Niguel, Mission Viejo (YMCA branches), CA
what_you_do: You can help at YMCA special events at age 14 and up. Events include golf tournaments and 5K races. At 16 and up, you can take an ongoing role. Roles include tutor, sports volunteer and Kids Zone helper.
who_can_apply: Ongoing volunteers must be at least 16. Teens 14 and older can volunteer at many special events. Volunteers under 18 need parental consent.
deadline_text: No dates listed. Special-event volunteering is seasonal, so the page says to stay tuned.
how_to_apply: The page has no general form. Open roles link to postings (examples: Tustin Expanded Learning Volunteer, Youth and Government MUN Volunteer, Sports Volunteer at Laguna Niguel). Questions go through the contact form at ymcaoc.org/contact-us/.
notes: All ongoing volunteers complete an online orientation, child abuse prevention training and role training. Screening includes an application, waiver, ID copy and background check, with extra checks for higher-responsibility roles. Court-ordered community service is not accepted. The YMCA of Orange County Model Legislature and Court page describes the statewide YMCA Youth and Government program, so it is not listed separately.
